def failure_line_summary(formatter, failure_line):
    """
    Create a mozlog formatted error summary string from the given failure_line.

    Create a string which can be compared to a TextLogError.line string to see
    if they match.
    """
    line = failure_line.line
    line_summary = []
    line_summary.append(line.file_name)
    line_summary.append(str(line.line_number))
    line_summary.append(line.line)
    line_summary.append(line.message)
    line_summary.append(line.test)
    line_summary.append(line.stack)
    return '|'.join(line_summary)

def failure_line_to_textlog_error(formatter, failure_line):
    """
    Convert the given failure_line to a TextLogError.

    This function is used to convert failure_line objects to TextLogError objects
    in order to compare them to TextLogError objects that are already in the
    database.
    """
    line = failure_line.line
    return TextLogError(
        file_name=line.file_name,
        line_number=line.line_number,
        line=line.line,
        message=line.message,
        test=line.test,
        stack=line.stack)
